'''Gronk''' was a [[Reigat]] who worked as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for the [[black marketeer]] [[Burgo Teage]]. He traveled with Teage aboard the [[Vohai Unirail]] where he confronted the [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Sienn Sconn]] when he broke into Teage's cabin.<ref name="TFO" />
